QuestInfo.name: Arena of the Ice Knight
QuestInfo.0: #p9070005#, guide of #m960000000#, has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: #p9070005# asks you to try out the new Ice Knight mode in #b#m960000000##k. You will get a gift for \rgetting a score of 200 in Ice Knight mode\k... Talk to #b#p9070004##k and go to #m960000000#.

0.0: Hiya, #h0#! I've got some good news for you! #bIce Knight#k matches have been added to Battle Mode!
0.1: Long, long ago, there was a knight who was so eager to gain power, he put on some spooky cursed ice armor. In his memory, we created these Ice Knight matches. The way it works is...
0.2: When you participate in an Ice Knight match, a random participant will be transformed into the Ice Knight. In that moment, battle begins, and it's the Ice Knight versus everyone else! It's up to the #rIce Knight to defeat 9 Maplers at once#k!
0.3: Hey, you can listen to me blab on about it, or you can try it for yourself! Go join an Ice Knight battle, and try to get a score of 200!

yes.0: You know how to join Battle Mode, right? Just talk to #b#p9070004# in town#k and you'll be teleported to #m960000000#!

no.0: Huh? But this new Battle Mode is cool, I promise!

default.0: Haven't you done an #bIce Knight match#k yet? Just reach a #bscore of 200#k and I'll give you a gift!
